title: Finding the Temporary Bus Stop
context: Nina 和另一位乘客 Daniel 发现常用站点暂时关闭，一起寻找临时站。本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，题目为原创练习，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: The sign says this bus stop is closed today. Do you know where the bus stops now?
dialogue.zh: 牌子上说这个公交站今天关闭。你知道现在车在哪里停吗？

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.en: I just read the notice. There's a temporary stop across the street.
dialogue.zh: 我刚看了通知。街对面有一个临时站。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Is it near the coffee shop on the corner?
dialogue.zh: 是在街角咖啡店附近吗？

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.en: Yes, just beyond it. You can see a yellow sign by the bench.
dialogue.zh: 对，就在咖啡店过去一点。你能看到长椅旁有个黄色标志。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: I'm taking the number six downtown. Does it stop there too?
dialogue.zh: 我要坐六路车去市中心。它也在那里停吗？

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.en: The notice lists the number six, so it looks like it does.
dialogue.zh: 通知上列了六路车，看来会停。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Good. Is there a crosswalk nearby?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。附近有人行横道吗？

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.en: There's one at the traffic light. Let's cross there.
dialogue.zh: 红绿灯那里有一条。我们从那里过吧。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Thanks. I almost waited at the old stop.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我差点就在旧站等了。

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.en: I did too. The construction surprised me this morning.
dialogue.zh: 我也是。今天早上看到施工让我很意外。

dialogue.speaker: Nina
dialogue.en: Here's the yellow sign, and the number six is on it.
dialogue.zh: 黄色标志在这里，上面有六路车。

dialogue.speaker: Daniel
dialogue.en: Great. We found it before the bus arrived.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我们在公交车到达前找到了。

expressions.example: The temporary stop is beside the park.
The pharmacy is across the street.
The entrance is just beyond the bridge.

expressions.zh: 看来是这样。用于根据现有信息判断。
expressions.example: The notice lists the downtown bus, so it looks like it stops here.
Turn left at the traffic light.

pronunciation: temporary 重音在第一个音节；crosswalk 中 cross 和 walk 之间保持清晰的 /s/ 与 /w/。

practice.title: Part 1 · Buses
practice.prompt: Do you often take the bus?
practice.answer: I take the bus a few times a week. It is convenient when I want to go downtown without finding a place to park.

practice.title: Part 2 · A change in a journey
practice.prompt: Describe a time your usual route changed. Say where you were going, what changed, and what you did.
practice.answer: One morning I went to my usual bus stop on my way to work. A notice said the stop was closed because of construction. I read the sign and saw that the temporary stop was across the street. Another passenger and I walked to the traffic light and crossed together. We found the yellow sign and caught the bus there. I was relieved because I still had enough time to get to work. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Transport information
practice.prompt: How can transport companies help passengers when stops change?
practice.answer: They can put clear notices at the old stop and show the new location on a map. Updates online can help too, but signs are useful for people who have already arrived.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读后说明旧站关闭，询问临时站的位置、路线是否停靠以及如何过街。
practice.answer: Where is the temporary stop? Does the number six stop there? Is there a crosswalk nearby?
